title: Christopher Salem whistleblower lawsuit and legal fees
summary: On August 18, the committee voted 7 to 0 to recommend adopting Resolution 26-132. A deputy corporation counsel said July billings exceeded the available funds, and that the court dismissed all of Mr. Salem's claims against the county. One testifier opposed more legal fees, saying a developer was responsible for unfinished permit requirements.
